blocks.text: Buying a Detached House Under $1.8M in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Detached houses priced under $1.8 million represent the core of Maple Ridge's single-family market. In West Central (median 9,032 sq ft lot size in Q3 2026), Southwest Maple Ridge (median 7,200 sq ft lot), and Northwest Maple Ridge (median 7,201 sq ft lot), buyers find established 1970s–1990s split-levels, ranchers, and basement-entry homes on wide RS-1 lots—typically between $980,000 and $1,450,000.

In Albion (median 3,961 sq ft lot), Silver Valley (median 5,090 sq ft lot), and Cottonwood (median 5,995 sq ft lot), the $1.15M to $1.75M bracket delivers newer post-2005 two-storey-with-basement detached homes, often featuring high ceilings, open-concept main floors, and one- or two-bedroom basement suites.

blocks.text: Secondary Suites, Lot Sizes & SSMUH Infill Under Bylaw No. 7600-2019

parts.t: Under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 and provincial small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules, urban single-family lots inside the Urban Area Boundary with municipal water and sanitary sewer can qualify for secondary suites, detached garden suites, or multiplex infill depending on lot width, area, and transit proximity. Always verify whether an existing basement suite holds a final City of Maple Ridge building permit.

How do I check if a Maple Ridge house has a legal secondary suite?

A legal secondary suite or detached garden suite requires a completed building permit and occupancy inspection from the City of Maple Ridge under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, plus registration on the city's utility billing roll.
